notes.title: Soundtrack Available Now!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that the soundtrack is available to purchase on Steam! Now you can listen to your favorite Polychromatic songs anytime you'd like for just $2.99. And if you haven't bought the game yet, you can get the Deluxe Edition for just $10.99 which includes the game and soundtrack.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/408050/

notes.title: Launch Day!
notes.notes:
Today we're excited to release Polychromatic to the world. 

We've been working hard on Polychromatic for over a year and think it's a great addition to the two-stick shooter genre. We're looking forward to your videos, live streams, and your thoughts on our new game.

Now go out there and dominate those leaderboards!
